messages:
alex: heads-up — deploy-bot blocked promotion of payments-service:sha-abc123 -> stable. post-canary health 2/4 pods failing readiness checks.

deploy-bot: Promotion blocked: payments-service@sha-abc123.
Reason: post-canary readiness failures (2/4).
Checks: post-canary /health, DB-migrations sanity, latency spike >200ms on canary subset.
Logs: ```
[PAYMENTS-CANARY] 2026-03-20T09:12:34Z ERROR readiness probe failed: /health -> 503
[PAYMENTS-CANARY] 2026-03-20T09:12:36Z WARN migration-check: pending 0 -> ok
[PAYMENTS-CANARY] 2026-03-20T09:12:40Z INFO  p50 latency 210ms (threshold 150ms)
```

maria: ugh. is this an image regression or chart/values change?

sre-lead: quick look at release: chart bumped to 3.4.1 with a default connection pool tweak and env var change (NEW_RETRY_TIMEOUT). If image changed too, we need to decide: pin chart & rollback image, or rollback chart & keep image.

chen: I pulled the canary pods — env shows NEW_RETRY_TIMEOUT=750, old stable had 300. That could explain latency under load. image differences minimal (only a small logging tweak).

product-release: change window is 09:00–11:00 UTC tomorrow. We should avoid re-promoting until then unless it's urgent.

alex: proposal: rollback the stable to previous image (sha-9f8e76) immediately to restore traffic, then pin chart at 3.3.8 for now. We'll open a follow-up PR to re-run canary with NEW_RETRY_TIMEOUT=300 and load test. :thumbsup:

maria: I prefer pinning chart and re-testing in the window. Rollback image + pin chart sounds fine. who's owning the rollback?

sre-lead: I can run the rollback. Suggested commands: ```
# rollback image on stable
kubectl -n payments set image deploy/payments payments=registry.redwood/payments:sha-9f8e76 --record
# pin chart in repo
sed -i 's/version: 3.4.1/version: 3.3.8/' charts/payments/Chart.yaml
git add charts/payments/Chart.yaml && git commit -m "pin payments chart to 3.3.8 after canary regressions"
```

deploy-bot: Rollback job created: RB-3623456789. Will run in 30s. Notifying on completion.

chen: I'll open the follow-up PR with the adjusted default and add a small load test in the canary pipeline.

product-release: add a short release note explaining: "Reverted image promotion due to post-canary latency with new default retry timeout. Chart pinned to 3.3.8. Re-run canary after config tweak."
Please include Affected services and impact: brief degraded latency on canary only; no customer-facing errors observed.

alex: tagging @oncall for post-rollback watch. Also add a postmortem ticket if we see recurrence.

sre-lead: rollback done — stable now at payments@sha-9f8e76. Rolling back pods gracefully.

deploy-bot: RB-3623456789 completed: success. Stable verifies 4/4 readiness. Traffic rebalanced.

maria: confirmed 200 OK on /health for stable. p50 latency back to 120ms. Good. :party_parrot:

product-release: I'll draft the release note and schedule the re-promote for the change window tomorrow 09:15 UTC. We should require a forced canary with load profile + approval.

alex: agreed. action items: (1) PR from chen with NEW_RETRY_TIMEOUT revert + canary load test, (2) pin chart commit (sre-lead), (3) release note draft (product-release), (4) re-promote in window with manual approval.

deploy-bot: I will not auto-promote RB-3623456789 artifacts. Manual approval required for re-promote.

chen: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/payments/pull/412 — includes test results.

sre-lead: leaving watch on overnight. Will reopen if any alerts.

alex: thanks team. closing thread — will follow up in morning if we need further rollback/postmortem.
